record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Find classes of graded rings over which every finitely generated graded module has a rational Poincare series.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and let $R = \bigoplus_{n\geq 0} R_n$ be a Noetherian graded $k$-algebra with $R_0 = k$. For a finitely generated graded $R$-module $M$, the Poincaré series of $M$ over $R$ is the formal power series
$$P^R_M(t) = \sum_{i\geq 0} \dim_k \mathrm{Tor}^R_i(M,k)\, t^i.$$
We say $R$ has the rational Poincaré property if $P^R_M(t)$ is a rational function of $t$ for every finitely generated graded $R$-module $M$.

Identify and characterize broad classes of such graded $k$-algebras $R$ for which the rational Poincaré property holds; that is, find structural conditions on $R$ guaranteeing that every finitely generated graded $R$-module has a rational Poincaré series.
artifact.status_search_result: The general problem of classifying rings over which all finitely generated modules have rational Poincaré series remains open. Anick (1982) constructed local/graded algebras with irrational Poincaré series, ruling out a fully general positive answer. Rationality is known in numerous special cases: rings of embedding codepth ≤ 3, Gorenstein rings of codepth 4, codimension-four almost complete intersections, Golod rings, complete intersections, Koszul algebras, and many compressed Gorenstein rings. However, a complete characterization of the classes of graded rings with this property is not available, so the open-ended problem remains active.

status_evidence.title: The Poincaré series of every f.g. module over a codim-4 almost complete intersection
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes rationality of Poincaré series for all finitely generated modules over codimension four almost complete intersections.
status_evidence.claim: Rationality is known for specific classes (e.g., codim-4 almost complete intersections), but no general characterization is established.

status_evidence.title: Poincaré series of modules over local rings of small embedding codepth
status_evidence.snippet: Rationality of Poincaré series under small embedding codepth or small linking number.
status_evidence.claim: Various restrictive structural conditions imply rationality, indicating the broader problem is partial.

status_evidence.title: Hilbert–Poincaré series
status_evidence.snippet: Background on Poincaré series in commutative algebra.
status_evidence.claim: Standard background; Anick's irrational examples show no universal rationality.
